تناعست (form VI)
# تَنَاعَسْتُ (tanāʕastu) /ta.naː.ʕas.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاعَسَ (tanāʕasa)
# تَنَاعَسْتَ (tanāʕasta) /ta.naː.ʕas.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاعَسَ (tanāʕasa)
# تَنَاعَسْتِ (tanāʕasti) /ta.naː.ʕas.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاعَسَ (tanāʕasa)
# تَنَاعَسَتْ (tanāʕasat) /ta.naː.ʕa.sat/: third-person fem
